notes.title: 2025-06-05 - PC Version 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Fixes and updates are as follows:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused monsters to keep bouncing under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where parameters would sometimes decrease upon Awakening.
[*] Fixed crash when switching between Skull Island and the Antechamber tabs when awarding titles.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a crash during system setup.
[*] Fixed a bug when purchasing multiple mana bags.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
Please continue to report any issues in our Troubleshooting forum.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Explore the Unique Systems in Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero
notes.content:
Discover the strategic depth of Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero with its unique battle systems.

[h3]Confine[/h3]
The souls of your allies can be confined into weapons and natural objects to summon them in battle.
[previewyoutube=-QhqSDuNVdo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Confriend[/h3]
Confine souls into yourself to turn the tide of battle!
[previewyoutube=W58aDTlJr_c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Confire[/h3]
Your choices about what, when, and where to Confine your Phantom friends bring limitless strategic options! Trees and rocks aren't the only things you can Confine to!
[previewyoutube=yKKzJurH8ls;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A free-movement[/h3]
Where characters can move freely within a radius during combat!
[previewyoutube=oQl5Jacpsdo;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]+ Wishlist[/b] today and stay tuned for upcoming news!
